difficulty_reason: The joint obligation controls the extremal matching size under simultaneous distinct clique limits for every collectable relative-order pattern, rather than only a scalar Ramsey existence bound. The new human upper proof uses an oriented multi-interval intersection graph to force interval-wise separation or a controlled partition refinement, then organizes all quantitative losses along complete refinement chains. The paired construction recursively doubles specified coordinates and composes ordered blowups while tracking each pattern-specific clique size, so the interacting two-sided core exceeds ordinary Erdős--Szekeres and independence-number prerequisites.
